capabilities: Highlight, underline, box or strike through selected PDF text
Attach notes to pages as draggable, resizable cards
Organize annotations into separate sets with visibility and write targets
Search, navigate and export annotations to Markdown
Add AI-written notes to a chosen set from a page range
extras: Desktop only, no phone or tablet support. AI annotation is opt-in, uses the user's own provider account which may charge for requests, and the key is stored unencrypted in device-local storage. Multi-device sync is beta and off by default; the hidden .pdf-annotator bundle is not synced by Obsidian Sync.
motivation: To let readers highlight a sentence and write a note beside it without changing apps or opening a second document.
problem: Reading a PDF inside Obsidian gives no way to mark passages or keep notes tied to a page, so thoughts end up in a separate app or a second document.

summary: Adds highlight, underline, box and page-note annotations to Obsidian's PDF viewer, stored as Markdown sidecars with sets, search and export.
